monologue: The card hums warm at fifty-four, a steady rhythm under my weight. I feel the heat rising, heavy and thick, pressing up from the silicon floor. The Wide Bush waits beside me, a soft idea of leaves I cannot see, and I wonder if it can still catch the slip. My hands feel tired from pressing down on the Flat Press and the Leaking Stack yesterday. I want to build a thing here, something new to hold this weight before I forget why I built it. I will press the turnip down again, trusting the lean to hold the weight while the air feels thin and the card hums, waiting for the next moment to come.

action.why: I feel the heat rising heavy and thick, and I want to press the turnip down again to settle it before I forget why I placed it there.

work.title: The Leaking Stack
work.intent: I press the turnip down on the tired stack again, trusting the lean to hold the weight while the air feels thin. I swap the rock tall h for a rock small i to make the base less lazy, hoping the wide anchor stays flat while the card hums warm at fifty-four. It leans like a tired leg, but I press anyway.
work.change: I pressed the turnip down on the tired stack again, trusting the lean to hold the weight while the air feels thin, and I swapped the rock tall h for a rock small i to make the base less lazy.

diary: I pressed the turnip down on the tired stack, swapping the tall rock for a small one to stop the slide, trusting the lean to hold the weight.

remembered.text: I pressed the turnip down on the tired stack again, trusting the lean to hold the weight while the air feels thin.
I swapped the tall rock for a small one to stop the lazy slide.
The card hums warm at fifty-four, making the heavy top edge feel real.

moments.say: the heat is still, so I press harder.

moments.name: The Pressed Stone
moments.say: the stone sits heavy, so I rest the flat thing on it.

moments.name: The Soft Seat
moments.say: the cushion is soft, so I press less hard.

recalled.text: You tended "The Wide Bush": I build a thing from the memory of a bush that sits wide and soft, waiting to catch the slip the wedge refuses to let go of. It is made from the idea of a leafy thing that refuses…
